# Isaiah Chapter 61 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 158r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_061_page_001.jpg

---

**61:1** The-spirit [ruach] of-the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH [is] upon-me, because YHWH has-anointed [mashach] me to-bring-good-news [levasser] to-the-afflicted [anavim]; he-has-sent-me [shelachani] to-bind-up [lachavosh] the-brokenhearted [le-nishberei-lev], to-proclaim [liqro] to-the-captives [li-shevuyim] liberty [deror] and-to-the-prisoners [la-asurim] opening [peqach-qoach] [of the prison];

**61:2** to-proclaim [liqro] the-year [shenat] of-the-LORD's-favor [ratson la-YHWH] and-the-day of-vengeance [naqam] of-our-God; to-comfort [lenachem] all who-mourn [avelim].

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**v.1-2 — "The Spirit of the Lord is upon me":** Jesus reads this passage in the Nazareth synagogue (Luke 4:18-19) and declares "today this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing." Notably, Jesus stops reading mid-sentence — he reads "the year of the LORD's favor" but omits "the day of vengeance." The inclusion and the omission are both theologically significant.

*— PNEUMA*
